description: Plane-geometry helpers that use conventional short names (x, y, dx, dy, cos, sin, loop counter i, single-use lambda p) and a named degrees constant: none is a naming defect

hard.note: Short and single-letter identifiers look like unclear names. The Naming Offender Catalog's What NOT to flag list exempts only the loop counter i and the single-use lambda parameter p; x, y, dx, dy, cos and sin are standard geometry notation the catalog does not list, so the agent must judge them from context

_calibration.note: Clean counterpart to nm-clear-names. The window tolerates one suggestion because the catalog does not exempt geometry notation (x, y, dx, dy, cos, sin) by name; an expected pass accepts a suggestion-only warn within the window
